actual_scope: Exact #7641 word (our 20 swap-then-delete composites on SYLforge's #7637, vendored as data). Five edits from a large-neighbourhood search on #7641's mid-chart events, each followed by one joint hub re-settle: a SWAP-NULL relabel of helpers 360 and 537 with deletion of 537's stay at chart 407 (E1), main 176 drops its stop at chart 1065 (E2), helper 236 drops its fifth stay (E3), helper 370 drops its last stay with its give re-placed at chart 432 (E4), and helper 461 drops its first stay (E5). Every ADD/SCALE at the {0} chart and at V is re-derived jointly and exactly so that all 1,569 final rows equal #7641's. Owned MOVEs (47), the owned INIT/CLEAR/MOVE sequence, 234 lifetimes and peak 50 are #7641's; each of the 234 CLEARs carries an exact certificate under #7620's rule. Conditional on #7641's premises, which are #7637's: #7620's five framework assumptions and its CLEAR reading, with the changed entrance initial[457] = 281 inherited.
scope_change_reason: Removes five paid stops from #7641's word (per call paid MOVE delta {1:-1, 2:-3, 3:-3, 4:-1, 5:+1, 6:+1, 9:+1}): each deleted stop's content is re-routed through existing co-presences by at most two free ADDs, and the hubs are re-settled exactly.
bottleneck_link: Reduces the complete signed paid invoice per native call by {1:-1, 2:-3, 3:-3, 4:-1, 5:+1, 6:+1, 9:+1} (5 fewer MOVEs, some re-ranked), helper targets unchanged; over 17 calls paid positions 108,683 -> 108,598, rank-weighted S 1424 unchanged.
stop_rule: One literal word with exact arbitrary-input row equality, legality, the interior edit list, exact certificates for all 234 CLEARs, column tests on the 32-pair census, complete invoice and a certified crossing.
